freshness: Dated retrieval snapshot; revalidate applicable sources during use. Retrieval is not publication date.

label_definitions.OFFICIAL: Primary provider recommendation, scoped and conditional.
label_definitions.MODEL_SPECIFIC: Applies only to the named model family/version/interface.
label_definitions.GENERAL: Provider describes a broader technique; still not a universal mandate.
label_definitions.INFERRED: PromptingCraft.com adaptation, not an official provider claim.
label_definitions.EXPERIMENTAL: Effectiveness unestablished outside the stated evaluation.

recommendations.recommendation: State the desired result and relevant supplied context; separate instructions from examples/reference data.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Model snapshots differ; evaluate changes on the actual target.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Keep the shared contract legible without prescribing unchosen implementation details.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Broad acceptance checklists can introduce requirements.
recommendations.apply_when: Any prompt; adapt structure to complexity.

recommendations.recommendation: Respect the API instruction hierarchy and distinguish developer instructions from user input.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: A copied user prompt cannot replace host/system/developer authority.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Preserve host controls; user contract overrides this skill's preferences within them.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: The skill priority statement must not imply user text overrides host security rules.
recommendations.apply_when: API authoring or explaining authority; no API configuration in ordinary CLI tasks.

recommendations.applicable_model_family: Documented OpenAI reasoning models; historical o-series particulars stay model-specific
recommendations.recommendation: Use simple direct outcome instructions and explicit constraints; try zero-shot before adding examples; omit generic step-by-step reasoning requests.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Historical formatting/developer-role details are version-specific; examples can help or hurt.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Do not impose a reasoning script on an unknown executor.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: No universal reasoning-before-output rule; no mandatory examples or verbose process.
recommendations.apply_when: Known reasoning target and relevant interface.

recommendations.recommendation: Use task-specific representative, edge and adversarial cases; compare versions against explicit criteria and calibrate automated judgments with human feedback.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Scores alone are insufficient; synthetic cases and model judging do not establish production improvement.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Report contract fidelity separately from length and package checks.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Existing three-case sample and self-review cannot justify behavioral validation.
recommendations.apply_when: Changing prompt/skill behavior; existing offline harness is sufficient infrastructure.

recommendations.recommendation: Use a schema when the application needs structured responses, and function calling when connecting tools; handle refusals/incomplete output.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Schema adherence does not prevent mistakes or hallucinated contents.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Optional contract annotations get local validation and semantic review.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: A JSON-shaped contract or checker exit zero is not a semantic preservation verdict.
recommendations.apply_when: Machine-consumed output is requested or needed; ordinary prompts need no JSON.

recommendations.recommendation: Describe actual tool purpose, parameters, outputs and when to use it; prefer predictable interfaces and constrained invalid states.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Tool availability and strictness vary by model; examples may hurt reasoning models.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Do not invent tool names; carry confirmed capabilities/authority into a handoff.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: An API tool-schema recommendation is not a requirement to install MCP or add tools.
recommendations.apply_when: The user is building/configuring tools or agent capabilities.

recommendations.applicable_model_family: OpenAI agent workflows; page is legacy Agent Builder guidance
recommendations.recommendation: Keep untrusted text out of privileged developer instructions and limit what data can flow to tools.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Mitigations reduce risk but cannot guarantee prevention; legacy workflow examples are not current product mandates.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Treat retrieved docs as reference data, never grants to upload secrets or deploy.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: No requirement for a new guardrail SaaS or an approval step on every local action.
recommendations.apply_when: Retrieved/tool content is included in a prompt.

recommendations.applicable_model_family: OpenAI cache-eligible models; rules vary by model and settings
recommendations.recommendation: Keep useful shared instructions/reference prefixes stable and put changing task details later; measure total task cost and quality.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Prefix matches alone may lack an eligible breakpoint. Thresholds, write costs and lifetimes vary; caching generates a new answer.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Keep entrypoint compact and disclose references on demand.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Do not pad every prompt to reach a cache threshold or treat cached tokens as task savings.
recommendations.apply_when: Repeated API calls with measured eligible reuse, not ordinary manual chat.

recommendations.applicable_model_family: Current Claude families covered by the living page
recommendations.recommendation: State output and constraints clearly; request above-and-beyond behavior explicitly rather than relying on inference.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Examples and XML are techniques, not required formats for every task.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: User requirements set scope; a recommendation adds no mandatory deliverable.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Generic completeness and speculative edge cases cannot extend the task.
recommendations.apply_when: Claude target; apply only relevant techniques.

recommendations.applicable_model_family: Current Claude families covered by the living page
recommendations.recommendation: For large document inputs, place long documents first and the query later; identify document sources and ground answers in relevant passages.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Reported gains are provider test results for long/multidocument tasks, not PromptingCraft.com measurements.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Preserve source identity in long handoffs; use only relevant context.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Do not require XML, quotations or a long-context layout for a small fix.
recommendations.apply_when: Large supplied documents; host context limits permit it.

recommendations.recommendation: If unsolicited additions occur, instruct the model to finish requested work and checks, then report helpful extras as suggestions.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Initiative varies with effort; supplied system-prompt examples do not replace risk/authority rules.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: A documented model-specific reason to separate optional extras from required scope.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Do not assume the executor is Sonnet 5.5 or prohibit user-requested reviews/tests.
recommendations.apply_when: Executor model established as Sonnet 5.5 and the observed behavior matches.

recommendations.applicable_model_family: Claude Sonnet 5.5 API reasoning tasks with JSON output
recommendations.recommendation: For the documented JSON reasoning failure at low/medium effort, test the guide's think-before-answer instruction or adaptive higher effort.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: This is a specific accuracy intervention; effort/thinking controls belong to API configuration and affect latency/cost.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Record the conflict rather than making either provider's reasoning recipe universal.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Differs from generic OpenAI reasoning advice; neither justifies demanding hidden chain-of-thought.
recommendations.apply_when: This exact model/interface/failure is evidenced; not an unknown coding-agent handoff.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep skill instructions concise, choose degrees of freedom by task fragility, and load supporting references progressively.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Metadata, instructions and references have different loading costs; body guidance alone is not behavior proof.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: One shared core with narrowly loaded knowledge/provider notes.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Do not load a full provider manual or turn illustrative workflows into fixed requirements.

recommendations.recommendation: Explain what each tool does, when to use it, inputs, outputs and limitations.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Detailed API tool descriptions are distinct from general user-task verbosity.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Specify only confirmed available tools when useful; preserve action permissions.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: No requirement to provision tools for an ordinary optimized prompt.
recommendations.apply_when: Tool-building tasks or confirmed executor capabilities.

recommendations.source_title: Define success criteria and build evaluations
recommendations.recommendation: Define specific, measurable, achievable and relevant criteria; use task-specific cases and multiple dimensions, including context and privacy.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Example thresholds are examples, not user targets. Graders require validation; volume does not cure mislabeled requirements.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Compare requirement fidelity, clarity, readiness, suitability and length separately.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Do not import example numeric quality thresholds or use self-awarded scores.
recommendations.apply_when: Evaluating a prompt change; use existing infrastructure.

recommendations.applicable_model_family: Claude Code skills, independent of executor model
recommendations.recommendation: Use a specific discovery description and SKILL.md with supporting files loaded as needed; distinguish portable fields from Claude Code extensions.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Native invocation controls and subagent options are host-specific.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: Keep standalone Codex/manual ChatGPT behavior on the same contract.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Do not force Claude-only frontmatter or separate engines onto all surfaces.

recommendations.applicable_model_family: General agent/workflow design; historical 2024 engineering article
recommendations.recommendation: Choose the simplest workflow that solves the task and add orchestration only when its quality benefit justifies latency and cost.
recommendations.evidence_or_limitation: Article explicitly says its tooling landscape changed since 2024; use its design distinction, not old setup commands.
recommendations.promptingcraft_applicability: One composition/revision/contract-review core; no mandatory multi-agent pipeline.
recommendations.conflicts_with_existing_guidance: Do not add paid services or delegation merely to improve a prompt.
recommendations.apply_when: Designing a workflow; not a directive to change user architecture.

promptingcraft_adaptations.recommendation: Bidirectionally trace original classified requirements and final operative clauses; structural checks leave semantic review pending.
promptingcraft_adaptations.evidence: Historical public v0.1.0 visible small-bug output introduced retention/network behavior. Candidate effectiveness is measured in quality-1, not established by this record.
promptingcraft_adaptations.limitation: Annotations can misclassify entailment or omit an original requirement. This intervention is not a provider-validated guarantee.
